original: うちの13歳の娘ね、明日初めてのデートに行くのよ。

en.text: My thirteen-year-old daughter is going on her first date tomorrow.

original: うちの娘は、もう子供ではありません。

en.text: Our daughter isn't a child anymore.

original: ああいう娘は嫌だな。

en.text: I hate girls like that.

original: あの建物、私の娘にくれてください。

en.text: Please give that building to my daughter.

original: 私の娘だ。

en.text: She is my daughter.

original: 私の娘です。

en.text: She is my daughter.
